correctness.rationale: Headline (i): G_S=Cay(F2,S), S={a,A,b,B,abAB,baBA}, 6 distinct inverse-closed words, e not in S, 6-regular. Exhaustion over 6^3=216 and 6^4=1296 reduced products: 0 closed length-3, 66 closed length-4, all 66 containing adjacent inverse pair (backtracking); 0 non-backtracking closed walks of length 3 or 4. Independently re-ran girth.py: identical counts. By vertex-transitivity no 3- or 4-cycle anywhere. Explicit 5-cycle e-a-ab-abA-w-e has distinct vertices (tree-lengths 0,1,2,3,4) and steps a,b,A,B,baBA all in S (re-verified). Hence girth exactly 5. Rooted simple-cycle census {3:0,4:0,5:10,6:0} re-ran to identical counts. Headline (ii): tree-ball B4(e) has 1+4+12+36+108=161 vertices (recomputed); internal S-edge count 177 recomputed; archived B4_coloring.json covers all 161 vertices, root color 0, 0 conflicts over all 177 edges (recomputed), classes 93/54/14; C5 lies in B4 so chi>=3, coloring gives chi<=3, hence chi=3 exactly. Headline (iii): deterministic restriction proof — fixed proper root-0 coloring c* defeats every 4-move spoiler sequence by copying (any partial answers restrict c*, hence proper and root-satisfying), including adaptive I choices. Valid; 200-trial simulation is illustrative only. Supporting S-ball r4 (833 vertices, 953 edges) coloring archived with 0 conflicts (recomputed); tree-ball B5 (485 vertices, 537 edges) 3-colorability independently re-ran DSATUR (486 nodes, 0 conflicts). File-path failure of verify_final.py in isolation was an invocation-directory artifact (script expects output/artifacts/ path), not a mathematical defect; logic re-ran cleanly with inputs/ paths. Distinguishes proof (girth exhaustion, coloring checker, mirror argument) from experiment (random simulation).

originality.rationale: Route is EMERGENT_FINDING as declared; absence from topic.json is not adverse. Genuinely arose from target work: exact DSATUR + reduced-word exhaustion performed while executing the admitted depth-4 game-tree/ball audit on B4(e) under c0=0; directly answers the preset fallback's binary question (negatively, by proof) and corrects the admission '4-cycle/w-cycle' picture. Not a convenient replacement task. Substantive novelty: live-checked Marks (1304.3830) gives general infinite determinacy method for acyclic Delta-regular graphs; Conley et al. (1611.02204) adapt to hyperfinite acyclic setting; Bernshteyn (2004.04905) gives general LOCAL-to-Borel/measurable transfer + measurable LLL; Grebik-Vidnyansky (2205.01839) builds acyclic Ramsey/expander witnesses. None states, tabulates, or mechanically implies girth 5, chi(B4)=3 root-0 witness, or depth-4 no-go for this exact commutator-augmented S; w-edges create odd-cycle (C5) structure outside acyclic hypotheses. Internal prior scan hits are unrelated objects (fiber diameters, forbidden families, entropy census, etc.). No timestamp or failed search used as proof; comparison is substantive.

value.rationale: Ordinary full value standard with no presumption applied. Object (free F2-shift Schreier with S fixed by standard generators plus length-4 commutator) and invariant (radius/depth 4 = |w|) were motivated before computation by the Kechris-Marks/Borel-vs-measurable/LOCAL-transfer frontier; value not known or mechanically implied (admission incorrectly pictured 4-cycles; truth is girth 5). Result is an independently retrievable exact datum: certified girth-5 invariant with rooted cycle census to length 6; exact chi(B4)=3 root-0 witness (161 vertices, 177 edges); proved depth-4 spoiler no-go lower-bounding the game horizon at depth>=5 / C5 scale; plus S-ball r4 and B5 3-colorability data. Future researcher can reuse the C5 and 161-vertex coloring as gadget inputs, cite the horizon bound to avoid depth-4 search, and retrieve the finite invariant table without redoing enumeration. Narrowness does not defeat value under the exact-invariant rule; certification does not rescue an arbitrary object, but this object is non-arbitrary. Infinite halves (chi_B>=4, chi_mu=3) remain open and are honestly disclaimed; incomplete census does not erase the headline exact result.
